players.product: grid-scale battery energy storage (BESS) for data-center/grid power

quarterly_data.signal: Fluence's third fiscal quarter 2026 earnings release reports energy storage products and solutions order intake of 2.6 GW contracted in the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus 0.7 GW a year earlier (271%), and 4.2 GW in the nine months versus 1.9 GW (121%). GAAP gross profit margin for the quarter was approximately 5.1% (versus approximately 14.8%) and adjusted gross profit margin approximately 5.9% (versus approximately 15.4%), the adjusted margin primarily reflecting, per the release, the impact of delays to revenue, the initial costs of deploying new product platforms and an upfront cost for a planned long-term international battery cell supply agreement; adjusted EBITDA was approximately $(29.3) million.
